blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — With threats of intense heat looming over next year’s Fiesta Señor, church and city officials are tightening crowd-control and safety measures for the religious celebration. Augustinian friars at the Basilica Minore del Santo Niño de Cebu on Thursday, Nov. 12, outlined plans to manage crowds and prevent heat-related illnesses during the monthlong religious celebration in January 2027. These include limiting the capacity of the Pilgrim Center to 5,000 people. Organizers are also considering installing outdoor misting stations to help lower temperatures in the open-air venue. Fr.
